summary.text: Tessa Lynn Hodge is the Democratic nominee for California's 23rd District. She describes herself as a lifelong High Desert resident and a Licensed Clinical Social Worker with nearly a decade of experience, and says she is running on healthcare, jobs and housing affordability.

paragraphs.text: According to her campaign website, she was born and raised in the High Desert and has lived in the district her entire life; her grandfather served 22 years in the Air Force and later ran a print shop in Victorville, and her grandmother worked more than 30 years as a registered nurse, mostly at St. Mary's Medical Center in Apple Valley.

Describes herself as a Licensed Clinical Social Worker with almost a decade of experience working with vulnerable populations, from children in foster care to students needing mental-health services in school districts.
Has worked in San Bernardino County incorporating state and federal legislation into county policy and guidelines for county workers.
Advanced from the June 2, 2026 top-two primary, finishing second behind Jay Obernolte with 21.3% of the vote.
